Actually using counterfeit money to obtain goods is fraud (诈骗罪) or "诈骗" (fraud). Also using counterfeit currency is "伪造、变造货币罪"? Actually using counterfeit money is "使用假币罪" (使用假币罪) under Criminal Law article 176? In China, using counterfeit money is a crime: "使用假币罪". Also the act of swapping cash is theft? He took real cash from the seller by deception, which is fraud. Also he stole cigarettes (the goods) by deception, which is also fraud. Could be "诈骗罪" (fraud) and "使用假币罪". Also "盗窃罪"? He didn't take property by stealth but by deception, so fraud. The act of swapping cash is "诈骗" (骗取财物). Also "非法占有他人财物" maybe theft? But typical classification: using counterfeit money to obtain property is "诈骗罪" (if amount large). Also "伪造、变造、买卖假币罪"? He didn't forge, he used pre-made counterfeit. So "使用假币罪". Also "盗窃" maybe not because he used deception. So answer: 诈骗罪; 使用假币罪.

Check if there is also "非法占有" but not needed. So output format: [诈骗罪; 使用假币罪]<eoa>.
